privacy: Synthetic examples only. Never add real applicant data or live source orders.

cases.problem: Compact job/pay headers lost the wage and left a plus in the title.
cases.rootCause: A whole line was consumed as a position before extracting its currency token.
cases.source:

人力资源文员HK17770+
·38岁内，本科男女，粤语英语，2年经验
·8H，休4

·精通MS Office一般文书工作，包括档案存档、资料输入、影印、编写报告；处理办公室杂务，例如文件送递、银行入账；负责跟单及出报价单；接听电话
💰2K+2.82办证保险另计（劳务费900）

cases.problem: Numbered and decorated prose requirements were not classified.
cases.rootCause: Age/gender depended on labels or a male/female word at the start of a line.
cases.source:
电工HK$21,600+
●39岁以内，大专男女，略懂英文，3年经验
●每天9小时
●负责检查线路

cases.problem: The word quotation caused legitimate office duties to be discarded.
cases.rootCause: Price filtering matched a keyword without checking whether it named a document or a charge.
cases.source:
职位：文员
工资：HKD18000
要求：男，35岁以下
工作时间：每天8小时
工作内容：制作报价单、整理保险资料、录入费用报表；每周处理20份文件
报价：32000元，办证另计

cases.problem: Fees, wages, and employee deductions were mixed together.
cases.rootCause: All monetary text was either retained together or removed together.
cases.source:
岗位：司机
性别：男
工资：HK$22000+，津贴500
奖金：合格后每月1500元
备注：住宿扣2800；餐费扣款550；劳务费4200；上家全包价38000
工作时间：每天9小时

cases.problem: Unknown source text vanished without being displayed for review.
cases.rootCause: Unhandled lines fell through the parser and the review view guessed provenance from final strings.

cases.problem: Conflicting salaries were combined or the first one silently won.

cases.problem: Gender words embedded in position names were treated as recruitment requirements.
cases.rootCause: Broad substring matching ignored the role and sentence context.

工资：HKD18000
工作内容：接待男女顾客
